summary: Iteration 23 — final production QA polish pass (frontend-only). VERDICT: PASS. Every acceptance criterion in the review request is met. Tested at 390x844 (mobile) and 900x1000 (tablet) against the live preview URL. (1) DRESS ME PRIMARY CHANGE — confirmed: after auto-generation the description beneath the outfit is ONE short editorial line (observed: 'Fresh smart-casual polish for a warm, clear and effortless day.' on first generation, 'Fresh smart-casual polish for a hot, clear, easy day.' after 'Create Another Look'). Below the summary a clean piece list renders with UPPERCASE slot labels + item name rows and 0.5px dividers (observed: TOP · Light Blue Oxford Shirt / BOTTOM · Beige Chino Trousers / SHOES · White Leather Sneakers / BAG · Black Leather Tote / BELT · Brown Leather Belt). 'Save to My Outfits' works (button flips to 'Saved to My Outfits' with check + sagePressed background). 'Create Another Look' regenerates a fresh outfit + new one-line summary. Tapping any item opens the swap sheet ('Change Tops' etc.) with search bar + wardrobe grid and check-tick on the currently-selected piece. (2) BRAND SPLASH — gold calligraphic 'A' mark + Cormorant 'Aureve' wordmark + 'STYLE · INTELLIGENCE · YOU' tagline renders on ink background, splash is still visible at ~2.0s and clears after ~3.5s (index.tsx enforces 2400 ms minimum via setTimeout). Fade + subtle rise animation confirmed via Reanimated. (3) PROFILE ACCOUNT SECTION — guest mode: only a single row 'Exit guest mode' in red (colors.error #C46A5C) with log-out icon; Switch account is correctly hidden. handleSignOut → router.replace('/') → index.tsx redirects to /login (since aureve_launched + aureve_onboarded are true) — no getting stuck on tabs. Signed-in path (verified via code review in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx lines 327-342): Switch account + red Sign out both rendered when !isGuest. NOTE: seeded bearer 'test-session-token-aura-123' currently returns 401 from /api/auth/session so the signed-in variant could not be exercised end-to-end in the browser — flagged as a data/backend issue, not a UI bug. (4) UI/UX CONSISTENCY AUDIT across Home, Wardrobe, Dress Me, Outfit Result, My Outfits, Profile, Style Profile, Beauty, Health Report, Missing Piece (in Profile), Premium, Collections, Add Item, Onboarding — Inter typography, Semibold headers, kickers with letter-spacing 1.2–2.0, warm ivory surface #FAF9F6, charcoal #232323 text, sage #97AC87 CTAs, gold accent on splash. Spacing rhythm sits on the 4/8/12/16/24/32 scale throughout. Buttons consistent (52px primary height, radius.md). Icons use Feather with matching weights. Back button + editorial kicker/title/subtitle hierarchy repeats across Dress Me, Profile, Collections, health-report, beauty. Safe-area insets honoured on all screens with useSafeAreaInsets. (5) RESPONSIVE — NO horizontal overflow at 390px OR 900px on Home, Wardrobe, Dress Me, Outfits, Collections, Profile (documentElement scrollWidth == clientWidth == viewport width, verified via JS). Only pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' props) in console — inherited from earlier iterations, not introduced by this session's changes.

integration_issues.issue: Provided seeded token 'test-session-token-aura-123' is rejected by POST /api/auth/session (401). Blocks browser verification of the signed-in variant of the Account section (Switch account + red Sign out). Code path verified via review of profile.tsx L327-342 (correctly renders both for !isGuest). Main agent may want to re-seed the token or expose a dev-only sign-in shortcut for QA.

issues: At 900px the Home layout stays a single narrow column with wide empty side gutters. Nothing overflows and the design is intentional, but a 2-column Quick Actions grid via useWindowDimensions would better fill the canvas on tablet. Not part of the review request — reporting as an observation only.

Flatlay images (230x170) render centred against a large empty background at 900px width. No overflow, but visually feels a bit adrift on tablet. Consider scaling image width with useWindowDimensions for a fuller canvas. Observation only.

critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx (585 lines) is now brushing up against the 700-line soft ceiling — extracting the account-card + missing-piece + rank-list sub-sections into their own components would keep the file lean.

BrandSplash.tsx: minimum-hold is enforced from index.tsx (2400 ms setTimeout) rather than inside the component. Fine for now, but if BrandSplash is ever reused elsewhere the 2.4s guarantee will be lost — consider colocating the minimum-hold inside BrandSplash itself.
dressme.tsx: styles.headerTitle is declared but never used (leftover from prior header design). Safe to remove.
